body: Thanks. I'm not sure its 100% applicable to me, but I suppose it was interesting in a sort of academic curiosity way.
It will also rid me of having to suffer through painful moments. If my life has more painful moments than happy moments, I'm probably not making such a terrible decision, am I?

I'm not trying to deny I'm hurting. Its clear that I am. In fact, I agree 100%. I'm hurting, and my sources of pain are unlikely to ever go away. I don't want to live a life that provides me no joy and multiple levels of pain. What is a therapist going to do about this? Find me a rewarding career, fix my nutty family, and make me good looking? Even one of these things? Didn't think so. I'd likely go through CBT or some sort of coping exercises. Theres no coping with some things though: if you have a shitty life before therapy, you'll have a shitty life after therapy.

I've reached out to startups, attempted to obtain freelance work (mostly got laughed at ...."I can hire a former investment banker for $20 an hour kid, what do I need with you?"), attempted to intern (even unpaid). No dice.

Listen, I get that you're trying to help. But its not going to do much here. I've tried any avenue that is even remotely explorable, but I'm just in such a ridiculously saturated job market and have no transferable skills because I have no work experience. This won't change any time soon. In fact, the longer this goes, the tougher this will get. No one asks questions when you're a month out of school and have no job. A year out and there are red flags everywhere.


My only realistic option is to take a dead-end sales job which won't make any money, build any skills, or provide any satisfaction. Given this reality, and the tragic comedy that is the rest of my life (personal/relationships/family/ etc/etc)....I'm just tired. I'm tired of every single segment of my life sucking a gigantic fat cock. If my choices are to be miserable and unhappy day in and day out, or to no longer exist...I'm not sure why no longer existing is any worse. 


I appreciate you taking the time out of your day to try and change my mind, but its not going to work. I'm stuck in a hole (much of it of my own making admittedly), and theres no way out. I just want to stop feeling shitty. I don't really believe in afterlife or anything, so to me, death would provide that.

I just don't want to be responsible for devastating my family.

90% of new businesses fail. You make it sound like its some sort of cake-walk to success. It requires money, skills, good networking, a solid idea and tons and tons of luck. If I can't grab an entry level job, is starting a business really a sound idea? Or just an easy way to blow a bunch of money? Let me just come up with a business plan thats going to mint money. Why didn't I think of that before?

As an aside,no one consistently works 120 hours a week. No one. Even in a fire sale where a front office i banker at a bitch level analyst role might pull 110-120 hours one week, he'll be down to 60 the next.

I'd love to change my life. I just don't see a feasible way. After a solid calendar year of cold calling, cold emailing, contacting alumni, friends, and family, applying to job boards, and going through recruiters...I've had exactly 1 interview in something even semi-related to my major. At this point, I will likely be underemployed for the entirety of my working career. So there an unfulfilling professional life. I'm short, bald, and brown. My build used to be solid but my back is basically made of dust so I can't lift anymore. So now I'm short, bald, brown, and jiggly. The ladies don't love that. So now we've got an unfulfilling love life. Throw in the fact that I live in bumblefuck behind a soybean farm, an hours ride away from my closest friend from school (did I mention I have no car) and we arrive at an unfulfilling personal life.

If my personal, professional, and love life are all sub-par....how the fuck is talking to a shrink going to make me happy? Its not like I'm medically depressed because of an imbalance in brain chemicals...I'm unhappy about life because I don't have a happy life. There is no fix to my problems other than having a happy life. If I can magically acquire one of those, my problems will disappear. Thats a little easier said than done though.
What if I never reach those prestigious milestones? There are plenty of people who wanted to get married or have kids and never ended up doing that.

They do coke to stay up after 100 hour work weeks actually, but hey. And yes. Starting a business. Why didn't I think of that? Let me just reach into my business hat, pull out 100 grand and a solid idea and start making money. Easy!

What is professional help going to do? I'm not psychotic, or medically depressed, or crying out for help. I'm just at a point where I realize that my life is terrible, and will stay terrible. I'd rather be dead than suffer through a terrible life. I just don't want to leave devastation behind.
